Seeker is a tool that leverages social engineering by hosting a fake website to trick users into granting location permissions. Upon granting permission, it collects precise location data (longitude, latitude, accuracy, altitude) and various device information (unique ID, model, OS, hardware specs, IP addresses) without requiring explicit device permissions.

NoteGen is a local-first Markdown application designed to streamline the process of capturing and organizing information. It allows users to quickly save various types of content, such as text, voice recordings, screenshots, and links, without immediate organization. Later, users can select related captured items and use AI to organize them into structured Markdown notes, facilitating efficient knowledge management.
